description: This file contains the implementation of the UpdateChecker class for managing app updates, including methods for suggesting updates based on version info, signers, release channels, and compatibility checks within the F-Droid project.

classes.name: PackagePreference
classes.description: Interface defining app preferences related to update behavior, such as ignoring version codes and release channels.

classes.name: UpdateChecker
classes.description: Class responsible for determining suitable app updates based on version info, signers, release channels, and compatibility.

methods.name: getUpdate
methods.description: Returns the suggested update version for the given package info and version list, considering signers, release channels, and vulnerabilities.

methods.name: getSuggestedVersion
methods.description: Suggests a version for a new installation based on preferred signer and release channels.

methods.name: getUpdates
methods.description: Provides a sequence of all possible updates starting from the highest version code, filtered by various criteria.

methods.name: hasAllowedReleaseChannel
methods.description: Checks if a version's release channels are permitted based on allowed channels and package preferences.
